stories.headline: Nvidia Partners with IREN to Deploy Up to 5 GW of AI Infrastructure, Can Invest $2.1B

key_facts.fact: Nvidia and IREN signed a strategic partnership to deploy up to 5 GW of DSX-aligned AI infrastructure across IREN's global pipeline
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia has signed a strategic partnership with AI cloud and data center operator IREN to deploy up to 5 GW of DSX-aligned AI infrastructure across the company's global pipeline.

key_facts.fact: Nvidia secured a five-year right to purchase up to 30 million IREN shares at $70 per share, creating a potential $2.1 billion investment pathway
key_facts.excerpt: The data center operator will issue Nvidia a five-year right to purchase up to 30 million shares of its ordinary stock at an exercise price of $70 per share.

key_facts.fact: IREN signed a separate five-year deal worth $3.4 billion to provide Nvidia with managed GPU cloud services for its internal AI and research workloads at its Childress, Texas data centers
key_facts.excerpt: IREN said it signed a five-year deal worth $3.4 billion to provide Nvidia with access to managed GPU cloud services 'for its internal AI and research workloads.'

key_facts.fact: Future deployments will focus on IREN's 2 GW Sweetwater campus in Texas, a flagship site for Nvidia's DSX AI factory architecture
key_facts.excerpt: The deal positions IREN's 2 GW Sweetwater campus in Texas as a flagship deployment for Nvidia's DSX AI factory architecture.

key_facts.fact: IREN earlier this week energized the first 1.4 GW phase of its Sweetwater campus and acquired cloud software company Mirantis for $625 million
key_facts.excerpt: Earlier this week, the company energized the first 1.4 GW phase of its Sweetwater campus and disclosed acquisitions of cloud software company Mirantis and Spain-based infrastructure provider Nostrum Group.

key_facts.fact: IREN previously signed a $9.7 billion multi-year cloud deal with Microsoft in November 2025
key_facts.excerpt: In Nov. 2025, IREN and Microsoft inked a multi-year $9.7 billion deal 'to deliver GPU cloud infrastructure powered by NVIDIA GB300 GPUs.'

sources.title: IREN inks AI infrastructure deal with Nvidia
Nvidia Places Massive AI Infrastructure Bet on IREN's 5 GW Pipeline
Nvidia to invest up to $2.1 billion in IREN as part of AI data center deal

stories.headline: Big Tech Offers to Fund SK Hynix Production Lines and EUV Equipment Amid Unprecedented Memory Crunch

key_facts.fact: Global Big Tech companies are making unprecedented proposals to SK Hynix, including investing in dedicated memory production lines and funding ASML EUV lithography equipment purchases worth hundreds of millions of dollars each
key_facts.excerpt: The firm's customers have been proposing a range of offers to the South Korean chipmaker, including investing in dedicated memory production lines... Another proposal involved customers financing equipment purchases such as ASML's extreme ultraviolet lithography machines.

key_facts.fact: One customer proposal targeted the first fab (Y1) at SK Hynix's Yongin semiconductor cluster, which has a total investment of 31 trillion won ($22.8 billion)
key_facts.excerpt: Big Tech firms have made direct investment proposals regarding the first fab (Y1), which SK hynix is building at the Yongin semiconductor cluster with a total investment of 31 trillion won ($22.8 billion).

key_facts.fact: SK Hynix is cautious about the proposals, as deals could lock it to specific buyers and force lower chip prices in exchange for revenue guarantees; available capacity is effectively at zero
key_facts.excerpt: 'Regardless of the type of offer, available capacity is essentially zero right now,' one of the sources said. 'There isn't even a small portion that can be designated for a specific customer.'

key_facts.fact: SK Hynix's Q1 DRAM average selling price jumped more than 60% QoQ, while NAND rose more than 70%, reflecting surging AI-driven demand
key_facts.excerpt: SK hynix's first-quarter DRAM average selling price (ASP) jumped more than 60% from the previous quarter, while NAND rose more than 70%.

key_facts.fact: SK Hynix has set down payments at about 30% of total contract value in long-term agreements, and is pursuing contracts with preset floor and ceiling prices
key_facts.excerpt: SK hynix, which holds the upper hand in supply, has recently set down payments at about 30% of the total contract value... The company is also pursuing contracts in which transactions take place within preset floor and ceiling prices.

key_facts.fact: SK Hynix shares have risen 154% this year to a record, making it Asia's third-most valuable firm by market cap after TSMC and Samsung
key_facts.excerpt: The company, Asia's third-most valuable firm by market value after TSMC and Samsung, saw its shares rise 154% this year to a record, thanks to growing investor bets on AI.

sources.title: Exclusive: SK Hynix flooded with unprecedented offers from big tech firms to secure chip supplies
Big Tech Offers to Fund SK hynix Fabs, Equipment Amid Memory Shortage

stories.headline: Sony and TSMC Announce Joint Venture to Build Next-Gen Image Sensors for Automotive and Robotics

key_facts.fact: Sony Semiconductor Solutions and TSMC signed a non-binding MOU to form a strategic partnership for development and manufacturing of next-generation image sensors, with Sony as majority and controlling shareholder
key_facts.excerpt: Sony Semiconductor Solutions Corporation and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited today announced the signing of a non-binding memorandum of understanding to form a strategic partnership for the development and manufacturing of next-generation image sensors.

key_facts.fact: The JV will set up development and production lines in Sony's newly constructed fab in Koshi City, Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan
key_facts.excerpt: Sony and TSMC intend to establish a joint venture, with Sony being the majority and controlling shareholder, to set up development and production lines in Sony's newly constructed fab in Koshi City, Kumamoto Prefecture.

key_facts.fact: The partnership aims to explore physical AI applications including automotive and robotics, leveraging Sony's sensor design expertise alongside TSMC's process technology and manufacturing excellence
key_facts.excerpt: This partnership also seeks to explore and address emerging opportunities in physical AI applications, such as automotive and robotics, paving the way for future innovations.

key_facts.fact: Investments are being considered on the premise they would be implemented in phases based on market demand and would receive support from the Japanese government
key_facts.excerpt: These investments, along with new capital investment by Sony in its existing plant in Nagasaki, are being considered on the premise that they would be implemented in phases based on market demand, and that they would receive support from the Japanese government.

stories.headline: Baidu's AI Chip Unit Kunlunxin Launches STAR Board IPO, Pursuing A+H Dual Listing

key_facts.fact: Kunlunxin formally launched STAR Board IPO counseling on May 7, with CICC (China International Capital Corporation) as the sponsor
key_facts.excerpt: 昆仑芯(北京)科技股份有限公司于2026年5月7日正式启动科创板上市辅导，中国国际金融担任辅导机构。

key_facts.fact: Kunlunxin had already submitted a confidential listing application to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on January 1, making this a dual A+H listing strategy
key_facts.excerpt: 该公司已于1月1日以保密形式向港交所提交主板上市申请，计划通过全球发售分拆上市。

key_facts.fact: Baidu holds a 57.67% stake in Kunlunxin and will retain control after the spinoff
key_facts.excerpt: 作为百度旗下AI芯片业务主体，昆仑芯分拆后仍将由百度控股，当前持股比例达57.67%。

key_facts.fact: China International Capital Research estimates domestic GPU companies list on Hong Kong at 30-100 billion HKD valuations, with Kunlunxin expected at the upper end; its value contribution to Baidu could be ~500 billion HKD or 25% of Baidu's market cap
key_facts.excerpt: 中银国际研究团队认为，国内GPU公司在港股上市的预期估值为300亿至1,000亿港元左右，昆仑芯估值应该处于这个区间的上缘...目前昆仑芯对百度的估值贡献应有500亿港元，相当于其市值的25%。

key_facts.fact: Kunlunxin's third-generation P800 chip delivers 345 TFLOPS FP16 and supports 10,000-GPU cluster training; external revenue exceeded 50% of total in 2025
key_facts.excerpt: 其核心产品第三代P800芯片FP16算力达345TFLops，支持万卡集群训练...2025年，昆仑芯外部收入占比超50%。

昆仑芯启动科创板上市辅导 同步推进A+H两地上市

stories.headline: US Suspects Thailand's OBON Corp Smuggled $2.5B in Nvidia Servers to China via Super Micro Scheme

key_facts.fact: Bangkok-based OBON Corp has been identified as the unnamed Southeast Asian 'Company-1' in the US indictment over Super Micro co-founder Wally Liaw's alleged chip smuggling scheme
key_facts.excerpt: The Southeast Asian firm the prosecutors didn't name, identified only as Company-1, is Bangkok-based OBON Corp., the people said.

key_facts.fact: US prosecutors allege Super Micro co-founder Wally Liaw worked with an unnamed Southeast Asian company and brokers to divert AI servers containing export-controlled Nvidia chips to China, with Alibaba among end customers
key_facts.excerpt: A key company behind Thailand's national AI effort is suspected of helping to smuggle billions of dollars worth of Super Micro Computer Inc. servers containing advanced Nvidia Corp. chips to China, with Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. one of multiple end customers.

key_facts.fact: The intermediary purchased approximately $2.5 billion in Super Micro inventory during 2024-2025; prosecutors valued diverted servers at $510 million during spring 2025 alone
key_facts.excerpt: Prosecutors value the diverted servers at $510 million during spring 2025 alone. Over 2024-2025, the intermediary purchased about $2.5 billion in inventory.

key_facts.fact: OBON participated in launching Siam AI, which became the first official Nvidia cloud partner in Thailand, connecting the smuggling allegations to Thailand's national AI ambitions
key_facts.excerpt: OBON, société basée en Thaïlande, a participé au lancement de Siam AI, devenu le premier partenaire cloud officiel de Nvidia dans le pays.

key_facts.fact: Dummy servers were placed in auditor staging rooms while real units were sent to undisclosed Chinese institutes; serial stickers were altered using hair dryers, according to the FBI
key_facts.excerpt: Dummy servers occupied auditor staging rooms, while real units continued to undisclosed Chinese institutes... Boxes even carried altered serial stickers applied with hair dryers, according to the FBI.

sources.title: US Said to Suspect Nvidia Chips Smuggled to Alibaba Via Thailand
Supermicro Indictment Deepens SMCI Risk for AI Supply Chain

stories.headline: CoreWeave Q1 Revenue Up 112% YoY to $2.08B with $99.4B Backlog; Q2 Guidance Disappoints

key_facts.fact: CoreWeave reported Q1 revenue of $2.08 billion, up 112% YoY and 32% QoQ, beating the $1.97 billion analyst estimate
key_facts.excerpt: Revenue $2,078 [million] vs $982 [million prior year].

key_facts.fact: Revenue backlog reached $99.4 billion as CoreWeave booked more than $40 billion in new commitments during the quarter, its strongest bookings quarter ever
key_facts.excerpt: Revenue backlog was $99.4 billion as of March 31, 2026... 'This was the strongest bookings quarter in CoreWeave's history, with revenue backlog reaching nearly $100 billion.'

key_facts.fact: CoreWeave surpassed 1 GW of active power and expanded total contracted power to over 3.5 GW, targeting 8 GW by 2030
key_facts.excerpt: We surpassed 1 GW of active power and believe we are well on our way to more than 8 GW by 2030.

key_facts.fact: Key customer wins included a new $21 billion commitment from Meta signed in March, and a multi-year agreement with Anthropic for Claude model development
key_facts.excerpt: Executed multiple new agreements with Meta, including a new $21 billion commitment signed in March. Signed multi-year agreement with Anthropic.

key_facts.fact: Inference now represents more than 50% of consumed compute on the platform, with GPU pricing increasing
key_facts.excerpt: Inference now represents >50% of consumed compute, saw GPU pricing increases.

key_facts.fact: Despite strong revenue, CoreWeave posted a net loss of $740 million with $536 million in interest expense; CRWV shares dropped 8%+ after hours on light Q2 guidance
key_facts.excerpt: Net loss $740 [million]... Interest expense, net $536 [million].

key_facts.fact: Management reaffirmed FY26 revenue guidance of $12-13 billion and raised the low end of 2026 exit ARR expectations
key_facts.excerpt: Management reaffirmed FY26 revenue guidance ($12B–$13B) and raised the low end of 2026 exit ARR expectations.

stories.headline: Khosla-Backed Genesis AI Unveils GENE-26.5 Model and Human-Like Robotic Hand That Can Cook

key_facts.fact: Genesis AI unveiled GENE-26.5, its first foundational model for robotics, capable of running a range of robots including those made by other companies
key_facts.excerpt: Genesis AI, a startup that raised a $105 million seed round to build foundational AI for robotics, has unveiled its first model, GENE-26.5.

key_facts.fact: The company designed its own human-sized robotic hand in partnership with Chinese company Wuji Tech, going 'full stack' from software to hardware
key_facts.excerpt: It comes with surprise hands. In a demo video, the company showcased various advanced tasks performed by a set of robotic hands it has designed in partnership with Chinese company Wuji Tech.

key_facts.fact: Demo showed robots cracking eggs, slicing tomatoes, cooking omelets, preparing smoothies, playing piano, and solving a Rubik's Cube — proving long-sequence dexterous manipulation
key_facts.excerpt: Genesis has also tasked its robots with preparing smoothies, playing the piano, and solving Rubik's cube... Gervet's personal favorite is cooking, because it proves that the robot has been able to complete a long series of difficult tasks.

key_facts.fact: Genesis developed sensor-loaded gloves that act as real-life doubles of the robotic hand, enabling collection of human manipulation data at scale to bridge the 'embodiment gap'
key_facts.excerpt: 'Our idea was that if we could design a robotic hand that tries to mimic a human hand as much as possible, we can instantly unlock huge amounts of human data without having to worry about what people call the embodiment gap.'

key_facts.fact: The French startup raised a $105 million seed round co-led by Eclipse and Khosla Ventures, with backing from Eric Schmidt, Xavier Niel, and Bpifrance; it has ~60 staff split between US and Europe
key_facts.excerpt: The seed funding round last year was co-led by Eclipse and Khosla Ventures, with additional backing from Bpifrance... former Google chief Eric Schmidt, telecoms entrepreneur Xavier Niel.

key_facts.fact: Genesis is in advanced talks with potential customers in France, Germany and Italy, targeting automotive, electronics, pharmaceuticals and logistics sectors
key_facts.excerpt: It is in advanced talks with potential customers in France, Germany and Italy... targeting sectors such as automotive, electronics, pharmaceuticals and logistics.
